payload.headline: JUST IN - Department of War releases first tranche of UFO files, as part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE). The collection is housed at https://war.gov/UFO
payload.body: JUST IN - Department of War releases first tranche of UFO files, as part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE). The collection is housed at https://war.gov/UFO/ with additional files released on a rolling basis. @disclosetv
